title: How to Draw Lewis Structures Explained Simply | PUC Chemistry Class 11
description:
Water, sugar and cooking gas have no ions at all. Their atoms hold on by sharing electrons. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Chemistry (NCERT Chapter 4, Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure) we learn the covalent bond and how to draw Lewis structures.

You will see two hydrogen atoms share one pair, then build Cl2, H2O, O2 and N2 on the molecule bench as electrons move into single, double and triple bonds, counting shared pairs and lone pairs. We learn the four-step recipe (count, connect, complete, check), try it on HCN, and work out carbon dioxide (16 electrons, O=C=O). ISC students also get the coordinate bond in the ammonium ion. Then the exam trap, an original JEE and NEET pattern question on NF3 with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

This is Episode 40 of our PUC Chemistry series.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, NEET and JEE Main students. For NCERT, CBSE, ICSE/ISC, PUC, NEET and JEE students.

In this video:

0:58 Building Cl2, H2O, O2 and N2

1:57 The Lewis structure recipe
2:32 Count, connect, complete
2:37 Worked example: CO2
3:14 Coordinate bond (ISC)
3:35 Exam trap and where it is asked
3:58 Practice question (JEE and NEET pattern)
